title: Laumufarþegi Worker operations
description: The ways into the Worker and its Room Durable Object: two HTTP routes, the room's WebSocket and the messages it takes, and the room's alarm. BASE is /games/fresh/laumufarthegi.

entities.name: May I start a room?
entities.description: Tells the page whether this visitor may start a room, their name if signed in, and the sign-in path.
entities.authorization: None; the answer depends on mayHost: everyone when HOST_SIGN_IN is none, otherwise a signed-in icelander.net user with the games:play role.

entities.name: Start a room
entities.description: Makes a new room under a fresh code, with the caller as its host.
entities.transport: POST {BASE}/api/rooms with JSON {name}; then POST /create on the Room for that code
entities.authorization: Same origin (sameOrigin); then mayHost: anyone when HOST_SIGN_IN is none, otherwise a signed-in icelander.net user with games:play.
entities.result: 201 JSON CreatedRoom {code, token, playerId}: the five-letter code and the host's seat. The host's name is the one sent, or else the signed-in name.
failures: Not allowed to host: 401 with the message and the sign-in path.
Six random codes in a row already taken: 503.

entities.name: Open a room's WebSocket
entities.description: Connects a browser to a room; no sign-in, since the code in the link is the key.
entities.transport: GET {BASE}/api/rooms/CODE/ws with Upgrade: websocket; passed on to /ws on the Room for that code
entities.authorization: No sign-in. The code must be valid, and an Origin header, when sent, must be this site's.
entities.result: 101: a hibernatable WebSocket accepted by the room.
failures: No room with this code: 404 from the Room.

entities.name: Join a room
entities.description: The first message on a socket: take back a seat with its token, or take a new one with a name.
entities.authorization: Whoever holds a seat's token gets that seat; anyone else may take a new seat by name.
entities.result: welcome {token, playerId} to this socket, the player marked connected, the state saved and every socket sent its view.
failures: An unknown token and no name: error, asking for a name.
No name, a taken name or a full room: error with the reason.
The room no longer exists: error, and the socket is closed with 4404.

entities.name: Play an action
entities.description: Any later message: settings, start, clue, vote, guess, next, end, kick, claimHost or resetTopics.
entities.authorization: The socket must have joined; act() checks the rest per action: the host alone for settings, start, next, end, kick and resetTopics; the player whose turn it is for a clue; players in the round for votes; the stowaway for the guess; anyone but the host for claimHost, once the host has been away 30 s.
entities.result: The state saved, the alarm set for the next deadline, and every open socket sent its player's view; sockets of removed players get removed and are closed with 4403.
failures: Refused by the rules: error with the reason, to this socket only; nothing changes.
Not a string, longer than 2000 characters, not JSON or without a t: ignored.

entities.name: Run out a timeout, or delete an idle room
entities.description: The room's alarm, set after every save for the next deadline or a day after the last change.
entities.result: A room unchanged for IDLE_MS (24 h) closes every socket with 4404 and deletes its storage; otherwise tick() runs out a missed clue, the vote or the guess, everyone gets their view, and the next alarm is set.
